technical-data.invention-title: A SOLE FOR FOOTWEAR WITH A PUMPING ACTION FOR THE PART NEAR THER HEEL
SEMELLE DE CHAUSSURE AVEC ACTION DE POMPAGE DE LA PARTIE PROCHE DU TALON

nplcit.text: PATENT ABSTRACTS OF JAPAN vol. 1996, no. 02, 29 February 1996 (1996-02-29) -& JP 07 250703 A (KOICHI KAWAMATA), 3 October 1995 (1995-10-03)

abstract.p: We have invented a new sole with a pumping action for the part of the shoe near the heel, inside a cylindric pump, connected with channels near the front part of the foot connected to the outside part of the sole, with a valve for the passing of air. Therefore giving life and automatic movement of respiration and compression for the circulation of air for the inner part of the footwear, resolving all problems due to the loss of the circulation of air.

La présente invention concerne une nouvelle semelle de chaussure présentant une action de pompage au niveau de la partie proche du talon, à l'intérieur d'une pompe cylindrique, reliée à des voies situées dans la partie avant du pied reliée à la partie extérieure de la semelle, et comportant une valve de passage d'air. Cette semelle active l'aération et la compression de la partie intérieure de la chaussure et lui confère un mouvement automatique, ce qui permet de résoudre les problèmes dus au manque de circulation d'air.

description.p: A sole for footwear with a pumping action for the part near ther heel

This present invention can be used as a Sole for Footwear using charateristics that are needed to create a circulation of Air inside the shoe, techinically activated by a Cylindric action of a spring near the back part of the shoe with connecting channels towards the front part of the shoe for the passing of Air by Valves, for Air in the Compressive phase and a Breathing phase of Air Return therefore retaining an Automatic circulation of Air.
